A [[Chest of Burrows]] will spawn after defeating [[Frostmaw the Kinslayer]] in the final level of the [[Frostmaw's Burrows]] dungeon. Each player in the party may open the chest and will receive one [[Lockpick]] and one item from the drop list in normal mode (2 in hard mode). After the chest has been opened by every player, a countdown timer will begin and the party will be transported outside the dungeon after three minutes.
